source: Published Tudcum, Conconta/high-mountain and Veladero elevation anchors
method: Published elevation anchors and operation elevation range mapped to versioned route distance with linear interpolation between anchors.
limitations: Analytical aid only; intermediate elevations are interpolated from public anchors and published elevation ranges.
The 4,850 m high-mountain anchor reflects published corridor/operation context, not an engineering survey point.
Do not use for navigation, engineering, occupational-health or road-safety decisions.
